scope: production runner wired to ops-first commits on schema-19 without weakening the verification chain

changes.trait: RangeRepository::commit_range_ops — default None falls back to the envelope path; compact impl stages a parent delta, binds the candidate by staged-leaf equality with the approved merge, validates, and commits through commit_ops_update (same required-heads/binding/head-CAS semantics)
changes.runner: RangeRunner::commit_acquired_range tries the ops path for records-only merges (metadata_changed == false); envelope stage+prepare_range+commit_range unchanged otherwise and on legacy
changes.verification: check_frozen_inputs extracted from prepare_range and reused on the ops path; verifier base/segment digests and version identity still checked; the envelope combined_integrity_sha256 equality is replaced by staged-leaf == approved-records bar-for-bar equality (strictly stronger: content equality, not digest equality)
changes.startup: MarketBackend::open tolerates an absent database file (legacy backend; per-operation fail-closed preserved)

verification.integration: all test binaries green including data_stdio, official_market, sqlite_range_update

limits: acquire still builds the combined envelope internally and fixed(base) still materializes once per item — the ops path removes the JSON stage + envelope commit, not the provider-side envelope construction

daily-update wall time on the production path is now estimated ~95-120ms/item (~8-10min/5,221); the <=5min gate additionally needs acquire pipelining or a canonical-digest contract revision — decision point posted to the issue
